plainTranslation: A's depth and power meets B's dreams. The opposition pulls them into push-and-pull.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against your imagination, hope, and idealism.
summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against your imagination, hope, and idealism. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
